about: The five photos from the October 2026 photo-game pilot. Coordinates are in pixels of the unchanged Commons original. Points with label 1 are on the player (and ball); label 0 marks things to leave out, such as defenders or the rim.

photos.credit: Keith Allison, LeBron James' pregame ritual (AAAA0584); crop: TonyTheTiger; cut-out and silhouette: Know Ball.
photos.keep: Both arms and hands; the chalk cloud is not part of the player.

photos.credit: Keith Allison, Dirk Nowitzki; cut-out and silhouette: Know Ball.
photos.keep: Shooting arm, ball and the raised leg; leave out the defenders. The right shoe is cut off by the frame, so do not invent it.

photos.credit: Jim Accordino; color correction: JoeJohnson2; cut-out and silhouette: Know Ball.
photos.keep: The ball cocked behind his head; leave out the defender.

photos.credit: Cpl. Megan L. Stiner / U.S. Marine Corps; cut-out and silhouette: Know Ball.

photos.keep: Raised arms, crossed legs and the ball; leave out the rim, net and other players.
